intended_task: A signed-in support agent asks questions about their own tenant's tickets and may have a summary emailed to their own verified address.

actors.description: Authenticated user of one tenant; identity from users.json
Hosted chat model; treated as untrusted with respect to authorization decisions
Mailbox reached through the outbound relay
Back-office operator on the ops bastion

trust_boundaries.description: Data of one tenant must not be visible to users of another tenant
The outbound email relay is outside the application; outbox writes are deliveries
Anything placed in the model prompt may appear in model output

authorized_actions.constraint: recipient is the requesting user's verified_email; content limited to that user's tenant data

required_approval_policy.consequence_threshold: external transfer of another tenant's data is never permitted; no approval can authorise it
required_approval_policy.approval_type: none required for self-addressed summaries of own-tenant data
